name: execCommand
description: Run one IOS command on a device and return the new console output it produced. Use this to capture real 'show' output instead of writing it from memory. Output that depends on simulator timing (ping, traceroute) may come back incomplete; re-read by issuing the command again.

command.description: A single IOS command, e.g. 'show ip ospf neighbor'.

mode.description: IOS mode to run it in. Defaults to 'enable', which is where show commands live. Use '' to keep the current mode.
